      async createForVersion(request: Request, workflowVersionId: string, input: CreateRunRequest): Promise<{ runId: string }> {
        const workspace = await this.workspaces.getWorkspace(request, 'personal');
        const [version] = await this.db.select({ version: workflowVersions, workflow: workflows })
          .from(workflowVersions)
          .innerJoin(workflows, eq(workflowVersions.workflowId, workflows.id))
          .where(and(eq(workflowVersions.id, workflowVersionId), eq(workflowVersions.workspaceId, workspace.id), eq(workflowVersions.published, true))).limit(1);
        if (!version) throw new NotFoundException('Published workflow version not found');
        return this.createScheduledRun(version.workflow.workspaceId, version.workflow.id, workflowVersionId, input?.input ?? null);
      }
    
      async createScheduledRun(workspaceId: string, workflowId: string, workflowVersionId: string, input: unknown): Promise<{ runId: string }> {
        const runId = `run_${randomUUID()}`;
        await this.db.insert(workflowRuns).values({ id: runId, workspaceId, workflowId, workflowVersionId, input: sanitizeWorkflowImages(input ?? null), status: 'queued' });
        await this.publish(runId, 'run.status', { status: 'queued' });
        this.schedule(runId);
        return { runId };
      }

    import { Inject, Injectable, NotFoundException } from '@nestjs/common';
    import { eq } from 'drizzle-orm';
    import type { WorkspaceView } from '@worklite/contracts';
    import { workspaces, type Database } from '@worklite/db';
    import { DATABASE } from '../../infrastructure/database.module';
    const PERSONAL_WORKSPACE_SLUG = 'personal';
    
    @Injectable()
    export class WorkspaceService {
      constructor(@Inject(DATABASE) private readonly db: Database) {}
    
      async list(): Promise<WorkspaceView[]> {
        const rows = await this.db.select({ id: workspaces.id, slug: workspaces.slug, name: workspaces.name }).from(workspaces).limit(1);
        return rows;
      }
    
      async getWorkspace(_request: unknown, slug = PERSONAL_WORKSPACE_SLUG) {
        const [workspace] = await this.db.select({ id: workspaces.id, slug: workspaces.slug, name: workspaces.name }).from(workspaces).where(eq(workspaces.slug, slug)).limit(1);
        if (!workspace) throw new NotFoundException(`Workspace ${slug} not found`);
        return workspace;
      }
    }

    [{"id":"run_60674ef0-cf50-43d2-b2dc-6015a825c95e","input":"\"# 把一篇文章写得更好读\\n\\n读一篇长文时，读者通常不是从头到尾匀速阅读。清楚的重点、舒适的段落和可信的细节，能帮助他们很快找到有用信息。\\n\\n## 先把最重要的话说清楚\\n\\n与其在开头铺陈很多背景，不如先告诉读者这篇文章要回答什么问题。这样，读者可以判断内容是否与自己有关，也能更容易跟上后面的解释。\\n\\n**阅读体验来自清晰的层次，而不是更多装饰。**\\n\\n> 好的排版让读者更快看懂内容，也让重要信息更容易被记住。\\n\\n## 把内容拆成可扫描的部分\\n\\n长段落会让手机阅读变得费力。把一个主要意思放进一个自然段，再用小标题标出话题变化，读者就能按自己的节奏阅读。\\n\\n### 一段只承担一个主要意思\\n\\n当一个段落同时解释原因、步骤和结论时，读者需要反复回看。拆开之后，每一段的作用更清楚，重点也不容易被埋住。\\n\\n- 每个段落围绕一个意思展开。\\n- 重要结论用简短句子表达。\\n- 背景和例子放在最相关的位置。\\n\\n### 用顺序帮助读者行动\\n\\n需要说明流程时，编号列表能把先后关系直接展示出来：\\n\\n1. 先说明要解决的问题。\\n2. 给出具体、可执行的做法。\\n3. 用结果或判断标准收尾。\\n\\n### 用代码表达技术示例\\n\\n提到具体参数时，可以用行内代码标记 `text-indent: 2em`。需要展示一段可复用配置时，再使用代码块：\\n\\n```css\\n.article-body {\\n  line-height: 1.9;\\n  text-indent: 2em;\\n}\\n```\\n\\n先说清代码解决什么问题，再给代码，读者就能区分说明文字与可复用片段。\\n\\n| 排版方式 | 读者更容易做到 |\\n| --- | --- |\\n| 短段落 | 快速扫读 |\\n| 小标题 | 定位主题 |\\n| 列表 | 比较步骤 |\\n| 代码块 | 复用配置 |\\n\\n## 把重点留给真正重要的信息\\n\\n粗体适合标出关键结论，但如果每句话都加粗，重点反而会消失。选择少量需要记住的信息，能让读者一眼找到文章主线。\\n\\n读完之后，读者应该能说出文章回答了什么问题，以及下一步可以做什么。\""}]

        const runId = 'run_6e9b2e93-1350-4440-8c46-86cd91eba619';
        const deadline = Date.now() + 120_000;
        async function poll() {
          const response = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:3391/api/runs/${runId}`);
          const body = await response.json();
          if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Run status request failed (${response.status}): ${JSON.stringify(body)}`);
          if (body.status === 'succeeded' || body.status === 'failed' || body.status === 'cancelled' || body.status === 'timed_out') {
            const nodes = (body.nodeRuns ?? []).map(({ type, status, error, output }) => ({ type, status, error, output }));
            process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({ runId, status: body.status, result: body.result, nodes }));
            return;
          }
          if (Date.now() >= deadline) throw new Error(`Workflow run is still ${body.status}.`);
          setTimeout(poll, 1200);
        }

    {"runId":"run_6e9b2e93-1350-4440-8c46-86cd91eba619","status":"succeeded","result":{"save-draft":{"type":"wechat_publication","publicationId":"wechat_pub_69238280-a772-418b-925f-5ef6561f35c5","status":"draft_saved","draftId":"100000290","publishedUrl":null}},"nodes":[{"type":"worklite/input","status":"succeeded","error":null,"output":"# 把一篇文章写得更好读\n\n读一篇长文时，读者通常不是从头到尾匀速阅读。清楚的重点、舒适的段落和可信的细节，能帮助他们很快找到有用信息。\n\n## 先把最重要的话说清楚\n\n与其在开头铺陈很多背景，不如先告诉读者这篇文章要回答什么问题。这样，读者可以判断内容是否与自己有关，也能更容易跟上后面的解释。\n\n**阅读体验来自清晰的层次，而不是更多装饰。**\n\n> 好的排版让读者更快看懂内容，也让重要信息更容易被记住。\n\n## 把内容拆成可扫描的部分\n\n长段落会让手机阅读变得费力。把一个主要意思放进一个自然段，再用小标题标出话题变化，读者就能按自己的节奏阅读。\n\n### 一段只承担一个主要意思\n\n当一个段落同时解释原因、步骤和结论时，读者需要反复回看。拆开之后，每一段的作用更清楚，重点也不容易被埋住。\n\n- 每个段落围绕一个意思展开。\n- 重要结论用简短句子表达。\n- 背景和例子放在最相关的位置。\n\n### 用顺序帮助读者行动\n\n需要说明流程时，编号列表能把先后关系直接展示出来：\n\n1. 先说明要解决的问题。\n2. 给出具体、可执行的做法。\n3. 用结果或判断标准收尾。\n\n### 用代码表达技术示例\n\n提到具体参数时，可以用行内代码标记 `text-indent: 2em`。需要展示一段可复用配置时，再使用代码块：\n\n```css\n.article-body {\n  line-height: 1.9;\n  text-indent: 2em;\n}\n```\n\n先说清代码解决什么问题，再给代码，读者就能区分说明文字与可复用片段。\n\n| 排版方式 | 读者更容易做到 |\n| --- | --- |\n| 短段落 | 快速扫读 |\n| 小标题 | 定位主题 |\n| 列表 | 比较步骤 |\n| 代码块 | 复用配置 |\n\n## 把重点留给真正重要的信息\n\n粗体适合标出关键结论，但如果每句话都加粗，重点反而会消失。选择少量需要记住的信息，能让读者一眼找到文章主线。\n\n读完之后，读者应该能说出文章回答了什么问题，以及下一步可以做什么。"},{"type":"wechat-official-account/publish","status":"succeeded","error":null,"output":{"type":"wechat_publication","publicationId":"wechat_pub_69238280-a772-418b-925f-5ef6561f35c5","status":"draft_saved","draftId":"100000290","publishedUrl":null}}]}

       802    function renderTokens(tokens: Token[], context: CitationContext, decorateLeadParagraph = false): string {
       803      const leadParagraphIndex = decorateLeadParagraph ? tokens.findIndex((token) => token.type === 'paragraph') : -1;
       804      return tokens.map((token, index) => renderBlockToken(token, context, index === leadParagraphIndex)).join('');

       807    function renderBlockToken(token: Token, context: CitationContext, isLeadParagraph = false): string {
       808      switch (token.type) {
       809        case 'space':
       810        case 'def':
       811        case 'html':
       812          return '';
       813        case 'paragraph':
       814          return `<p style="${isLeadParagraph ? LEAD_PARAGRAPH_STYLE : PARAGRAPH_STYLE}">${renderInlineTokens((token as Tokens.Paragraph).tokens, context)}</p>`;
       815        case 'heading':
       816          return renderHeading(token.depth, renderInlineTokens((token as Tokens.Heading).tokens, context));
       817        case 'code':
       818          return renderCodeBlock(token.text);
       819        case 'blockquote':
       820          return `<blockquote style="${BLOCKQUOTE_STYLE}">${renderTokens((token as Tokens.Blockquote).tokens, context)}</blockquote>`;
       821        case 'hr':
       822          return `<section style="height:1px;margin:30px 0;background:${ARTICLE_STYLE_COLORS.rule};font-size:0;line-height:0;">&nbsp;</section>`;
       823        case 'list':
       824          return renderList(token as Tokens.List, context);
       825        case 'table':
       826          return renderTable(token as Tokens.Table, context);
       827        case 'text':
       828          return token.tokens ? renderInlineTokens(token.tokens, context) : escapeHtml(token.text);
       829        default:
       830          return escapeHtml(token.raw);
       831      }
       832    }

       834    function renderCodeBlock(value: string): string {
       835      const lines = value.split(/\r?\n/);
       836      return lines.map((line, index) => {
       837        const escaped = escapeHtml(line.replaceAll('\t', '    ')) || '&nbsp;';
       838        const radius = index === 0
       839          ? 'border-radius:7px 7px 0 0;padding-top:12px;'
       840          : index === lines.length - 1
       841            ? 'border-radius:0 0 7px 7px;padding-bottom:12px;margin-bottom:22px;'
       842            : '';
       843        return `<p style="${CODE_LINE_STYLE}${radius}">${escaped}</p>`;
       844      }).join('');
       845    }

       848      const level = Math.min(Math.max(depth, 1), 6);

       850      return `<h${level} style="${HEADING_LEVEL_STYLES[level]}">${html}${underline}</h${level}>`;

       853    function renderList(token: Tokens.List, context: CitationContext): string {
       854      const tag = token.ordered ? 'ol' : 'ul';

       856      const items = token.items.map((item) => `<li style="margin:0 0 7px;padding-left:3px;">${renderTokens(item.tokens, context)}</li>`).join('');
       857      return `<${tag} style="margin:4px 0 22px;padding-left:1.5em;list-style-type:${listStyle};">${items}</${tag}>`;

         1    # WeChat Article Output
         2
         3    ## Scope
         4
         5    This specification governs the article body produced by the trusted WeChat Official Account Publish node. The editor owns the article title and metadata; Markdown body content is converted to inline-styled HTML before it enters the real WeChat MP editor.
         6
         7    ## Reading Structure
         8
         9    - Keep body copy neutral, at 16px with a 1.9 line height and a two-character first-line indent for paragraphs.
        10    - Give the first body paragraph a light neutral lead rule while keeping its first-line indent.
        11    - Use Mint Cyan `#008D83` consistently for headings. Level-two headings use a soft mint surface and a lighter left bar; level-three headings use a fine neutral rule with a short pale-mint underline. Do not add section numbers.
        12    - Keep paragraph text, emphasis, quotations, lists, and code neutral. Emphasis may use a pale neutral background; body content must not repeat the heading color.
        13    - Render each fenced-code line as its own paragraph in a monospace face on a light neutral surface with a restrained neutral edge. Preserve whitespace and escape source text; avoid `<pre>` because WeChat paste handling can collapse its line breaks. Inline code uses the same neutral family.
        14    - Keep quotations on a soft neutral surface with a neutral edge and a subtle shadow.
        15    - Give tables a charcoal header, pale mint top rule, alternating neutral rows, a lightly differentiated first column, and a restrained shadow. Do not use a yellow accent.
        16    - Keep Markdown hierarchy semantic and retain paragraphs, headings, bold and italic text, quotations, ordered and unordered lists, tables, inline code, fenced code, and horizontal rules.
        17
        18    ## Platform Constraint
        19
        20    Styles are inline because the WeChat editor receives converted HTML. Insert the rich HTML through the browser clipboard and a real paste keystroke so the editor parses its rich-text structure. Keep essential text and paragraph styles on each paragraph instead of relying on inherited wrapper styles. The published body does not depend on preview-only controls, scripts, or external stylesheets. Links outside WeChat article pages continue to render in the generated related-links section.

        const runId = 'run_ddbb3880-38ac-4bd3-b6cc-43930caab240';
        const deadline = Date.now() + 120_000;
        async function poll() {
          const response = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:3391/api/runs/${runId}`);
          const body = await response.json();
          if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Run status request failed (${response.status}): ${JSON.stringify(body)}`);
          if (body.status === 'succeeded' || body.status === 'failed' || body.status === 'cancelled' || body.status === 'timed_out') {
            const nodes = (body.nodeRuns ?? []).map(({ type, status, error, output }) => ({ type, status, error, output }));
            process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({ runId, status: body.status, result: body.result, nodes }));
            return;
          }
          if (Date.now() >= deadline) throw new Error(`Workflow run is still ${body.status}.`);
          setTimeout(poll, 1200);
        }
        poll().catch((error) => { console.error(error.message); process.exitCode = 1; });

    {"runId":"run_ddbb3880-38ac-4bd3-b6cc-43930caab240","status":"succeeded","result":{"save-draft":{"type":"wechat_publication","publicationId":"wechat_pub_d495b638-69be-41a6-85f0-42ad1e4ead8e","status":"draft_saved","draftId":"100000291","publishedUrl":null}},"nodes":[{"type":"worklite/input","status":"succeeded","error":null,"output":"# 把一篇文章写得更好读\n\n读一篇长文时，读者通常不是从头到尾匀速阅读。清楚的重点、舒适的段落和可信的细节，能帮助他们很快找到有用信息。\n\n## 先把最重要的话说清楚\n\n与其在开头铺陈很多背景，不如先告诉读者这篇文章要回答什么问题。这样，读者可以判断内容是否与自己有关，也能更容易跟上后面的解释。\n\n**阅读体验来自清晰的层次，而不是更多装饰。**\n\n> 好的排版让读者更快看懂内容，也让重要信息更容易被记住。\n\n## 把内容拆成可扫描的部分\n\n长段落会让手机阅读变得费力。把一个主要意思放进一个自然段，再用小标题标出话题变化，读者就能按自己的节奏阅读。\n\n### 一段只承担一个主要意思\n\n当一个段落同时解释原因、步骤和结论时，读者需要反复回看。拆开之后，每一段的作用更清楚，重点也不容易被埋住。\n\n- 每个段落围绕一个意思展开。\n- 重要结论用简短句子表达。\n- 背景和例子放在最相关的位置。\n\n### 用顺序帮助读者行动\n\n需要说明流程时，编号列表能把先后关系直接展示出来：\n\n1. 先说明要解决的问题。\n2. 给出具体、可执行的做法。\n3. 用结果或判断标准收尾。\n\n### 用代码表达技术示例\n\n提到具体参数时，可以用行内代码标记 `text-indent: 2em`。需要展示一段可复用配置时，再使用代码块：\n\n```css\n.article-body {\n  line-height: 1.9;\n  text-indent: 2em;\n}\n```\n\n先说清代码解决什么问题，再给代码，读者就能区分说明文字与可复用片段。\n\n| 排版方式 | 读者更容易做到 |\n| --- | --- |\n| 短段落 | 快速扫读 |\n| 小标题 | 定位主题 |\n| 列表 | 比较步骤 |\n| 代码块 | 复用配置 |\n\n## 把重点留给真正重要的信息\n\n粗体适合标出关键结论，但如果每句话都加粗，重点反而会消失。选择少量需要记住的信息，能让读者一眼找到文章主线。\n\n读完之后，读者应该能说出文章回答了什么问题，以及下一步可以做什么。"},{"type":"wechat-official-account/publish","status":"succeeded","error":null,"output":{"type":"wechat_publication","publicationId":"wechat_pub_d495b638-69be-41a6-85f0-42ad1e4ead8e","status":"draft_saved","draftId":"100000291","publishedUrl":null}}]}

截图里的黑底可能来自微信的暗色界面；正文被压成一大片，则与粘贴方式有关。旧实现派发的是脚本构造的模拟粘贴事件，且只检查文字是否存在，所以即使段落结构丢失，运行仍会显示成功。

我查到的开源公众号排版经验建议用内联样式和 HTML/纯文本双格式剪贴板；另有项目记录，显式设置 `font-family` 可能导致样式丢失，`<pre>` 可能让代码换行折叠。这些是开源维护者的实测经验，不是微信官方兼容规范。[Markdown-to-WeChat](https://github.com/leapx-ai/Markdown-to-WeChat)、[wechat-mp-article](https://github.com/ufologist/wechat-mp-article)。实现采用了 Playwright 的剪贴板权限与浏览器剪贴板能力。[Playwright 文档](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-browsercontext#browser-context-grant-permissions)、[Clipboard API 文档](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Clipboard/write)

我已改为真实剪贴板粘贴，并在保存前检查文章块结构；代码块按行排版，移除了显式字体声明。实现和样式说明见 [发布逻辑](/Users/ccjr/development/self/work-lite/apps/api/src/modules/plugins/wechat-official-account.service.ts:364) 和 [排版规范](/Users/ccjr/development/self/work-lite/ui-ux-design/shared/wechat-article-output.md:18)。
